perks.name: Queensfoil Rush
perks.description: Gain a powerful overshield while performing your finisher. When you finish a target, release a slowing burst around you.
perks.exact:
Finishers grant a 200? HP Overshield for the duration of the finisher (+0.3s).

On Finisher:
Inflicts x? Slow to enemies within 7 meters.

perks.name: Truth to Power
perks.description: Gain increasing damage resistance when you deal damage or land final blows. Finishers grant accelerated progress. At max stacks, the recharge rate of your abilities is also increased.
perks.exact:
Each damage instance scored grants a stack of Truth, up to a maximum of x999 stacks. wherein it gets renamed to Power.
Kills and Finishers grant many more stacks, although it seems to have different gains depending on the stack amount.
Kills tend to be within 20-35 stacks. Finishers tend to give around 60-90 stacks. 
ALL stacks are removed on death.

Truth grants Damage Resist per stack, up to 15% DR at maximum.
250 = 3.75% | 500 = 7.5% | 750 = 10% | 999 = 15% Damage Resist

Truth to Power Effect at x999 stacks:
+50% Additional Base Grenade, and Melee Regeneration Rate.
+35% Additional Base Class Regeneration Rate
15% Damage Resist.
